name: LEVOCARNITINE 1GR/5ML INJECTABLE SOLUTION 5 AMPOULES
description: Levocarnitine 1 g/5 ml injectable solution is used to treat and prevent low levels of carnitine in the body. It is also used to treat hyperammonemic encephalopathy and/or hepatotoxicity due to valproic acid overdose. Carnitine is an amino acid that helps the body produce energy. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
